Dure is a playable character from the Grand Quest: The End of An Empire. He is the Second Prince of Bariura Empire, who wielded an earth chain-axe.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Dure is the commander of the expedition forces in the empire. He is often humiliated by his half-brother, although he never takes it with hard feelings.

During the Great War, Dure's given task is to intercept the enemies before they could enter the capital. Despite overwhelming odds, he does not hesitate to engage the God Army forces in direct battle. When he spots a powerful disciple heading to the East Gate, he passes the command to his lieutenant and rushes back just in time to save his younger brother. He just laughes when his ungrateful brother insults him, stating that as a brother he has the duty to protect his family.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: Known as an impulsive person at first, Dure is actually a kind and easy-going person at heart. However, he takes the duty to protect his family, particularly his siblings, very seriously.

He is the Second Prince of Bariura Empire, who wielded an earth chain-axe. ==History== Dure is the commander of the expedition forces in the empire. He is often humiliated by his [[Sareas (character)|half-brother]], although he never takes it with hard feelings. During the Great War, Dure's given task is to intercept the enemies before they could enter the capital. Despite overwhelming odds, he does not hesitate to engage the God Army forces in direct battle. When he spots [[Kajah (character)|a powerful disciple]] heading to the East Gate, he passes the command to his lieutenant and rushes back just in time to save his younger brother. He just laughes when his ungrateful brother insults him, stating that as a brother he has the duty to protect his family. ==Character== Known as an impulsive person at first, Dure is actually a kind and easy-going person at heart. However, he takes the duty to protect his family, particularly his siblings, very seriously. ==Relationships== ===Sareas=== Although Sareas often insults him, Dure never takes it with hard feelings. ==Trivia==
